note: Written before any v2.7 result exists. Motivation: reporting-only diagnostics (P009: clean 0.748 / corrupted 0.610 / no missing ball 0.700; R001: most lost spells are short). Only external data is used.
hypothesis: Features that bridge the ball across gaps (linear bridge <= 6 s, team geometry against the bridged position, following the player nearest at the last-seen frame to the next-seen frame and the reverse) recover part of the loss caused by missing ball samples.

change.unchanged: stage-1/stage-2 hyper-parameters, training seeds 1-3, step 6, stack.py, decoders (v2.1 path 3/60/60/-0.3, v2.3 path 5/60/60/-0.3), noise gate 0.30 m

stage_A_development.copies: 8 old validation copies (J03WN1, J03WR9, MET1, MET2; seeds 101/102), already used many times
stage_A_development.baseline: v2.1 with the same decoder on the same copies (0.6312)
stage_A_development.proceed_if: mean spellF1 >= baseline + 0.005; otherwise stop and record NOT selected

stage_B_confirmation_low_noise.copies: 8 fresh copies, profile v2, seeds 7100 + 10*i + j (i = match index in [J03WN1, J03WR9, MET1, MET2], j = 0/1)
stage_B_confirmation_low_noise.baseline: v2.1 models (4 training matches) on the same copies
gates: at least 5 of 8 copies not worse than baseline

stage_C_confirmation_noisy_path.model: feature version 3 on smoothed inputs, training profile v2.3 (as possession-v2.3)
stage_C_confirmation_noisy_path.copies: 16 fresh copies: val-ext-ball seeds 7300 + 10*i + j and val-ext-players seeds 7500 + 10*i + j
stage_C_confirmation_noisy_path.baseline: v2.3 path models (4 training matches) on the same copies
gates: at least 10 of 16 copies not worse
stage_C_confirmation_noisy_path.if_failed: keep possession-v2.3 for the noisy path; stage B decides the low-noise path independently

release_rule: A path that passes its gates is retrained on the 6 DFL matches and released as possession-v2.7 with a new source/bundle manifest; broadcast fill and clock alignment stay as in v2.5b. Reserved Metrica game 3 is reported once after the decision (not used for selection). J03WMX stays the final fresh test.
limits: Provider labels, simulated corruption; not competition scores. Gates are not relaxed after results.
